address: Chemin du Parc (Palais des Évêques), Saint-Lizier, 09190, France
bio: A stone’s throw from Saint Girons, this eatery is housed in a bishop’s palace, a listed building built into the Roman wall. Park your car and continue on foot to the restaurant located within the thick stone walls of the vaulted cellars. You will sample forthright food inspired by local rustic produce. When the weather is fine, bag a table on the terrace, which boasts a breathtaking panorama over the verdant valley and the village rooftops!...
